arguments.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one full-body visual-novel sprite of Zibai from Genshin Impact expressing fear. The supplied explicitly approved neutral is the SOLE image reference. Preserve its exact recognizable identity, face, skin tone, hair and eye colors, normal pupils, costume construction, accessories, proportions and detailed anime illustration style. In particular preserve its silver-white hair and gold streak, golden eyes, crescent ornaments, turquoise earrings, exact white-and-jade costume, gold fittings, fur-edged gradient sleeves, hanging ornaments, white legwear, stocking motifs and heels.
Build: keep the approved neutral's natural Tall Female proportions and body type. Maintain the same compactness without lengthening the torso or legs or stretching anatomy to fill the canvas.
Personality: independent, incisive, subtly wry and self-possessed, with humane warmth and the free spirit of the golden-eyed adeptus. Acting for this emotion: A sudden, restrained alarm breaks through her calm: wide golden eyes, lifted inner brows and a small parted mouth. Draw her shoulders slightly back and turn her head toward the source of surprise. Keep her right elbow bent with the right hand held at lower-chest height, palm angled sideways and fingers gently grouped in a relaxed curve; do not turn the palm flat toward the viewer. Her left arm hangs slightly away from the body, the left hand relaxed at hip level clear of the sleeve. A small backward weight shift communicates fear while preserving her composed bearing. Change the whole pose and body language for this emotion rather than only changing the face or mechanically copying the neutral.
Keep her predominantly in a graceful side/three-quarter body orientation derived from the approved neutral, while varying arms, head, torso angle and stance for the emotion. All stocking motifs, seams, gold trim and garment panels must rotate and foreshorten with the actual legs and pelvis. Never paste a front-view pair of legwear patterns onto turned legs. The head must turn naturally with the neck. Hand rendering: use natural human hands with a connected palm, four fingers and a separate opposable thumb. Give the fingers relaxed, coherent joints and a softly grouped silhouette suited to the gesture. Preserve the natural distinction between the thumb and the little finger. Let overlap follow the pose rather than forcing every digit to face the camera. Keep each hand separate from the other hand and clearly outlined against the transparent background, with a clean gap from adjacent fabric. Exactly two arms, two legs and two feet, with feet clearly distinct and uncrossed. Costume markings must follow the surfaces they belong to and turn in perspective with the body. Let hair and heavy costume panels follow the pose naturally with gravity. Preserve the established outfit fully. Use ordinary pupils; no heart pupils or floating hearts.
Complete silhouette including headwear, hair, hands, accessories, costume panels and shoes, with about 2–4% top and bottom padding and 92–96% visible height. Genuinely transparent background with clear alpha outside the character; no scenery, backdrop, vignette, glow, floor, ground shadow, reflections, floating effects, text, labels, UI, watermark, added props, weapons or additional characters.

approval.message: Zibai accepted, Yun Jin accepted. Mizuki: Confusion - distorted hands, Desire - distorted eyes, Embarrassment - distorted eyes, Excitement - distorted eyes. I think the issue with Mizuki’s eyes might be part of her neutral. Try regenerating the Mizuki neutral, and then use her in game model as a secondary reference for each emotion thereafter.
Yoimiya, Xinyan, Xingqiu accepted - try regenerating Yun Jin and Zibai
